question: especially, why is there no line out to an AI?
title: Why the tests hold no line to a model
summary: The e2e tests never call an AI themselves: they start docair serve with the AI settings pointed at the fake model, and the only lines to a model in the graph run out of docair's own client, which the fake endpoint answers.

steps.title: The tests start docair serve pointed at the fake model
steps.text: `e2e.serve` runs `docair serve` on a copy of a fixture with the AI settings from `fakeAiEnv`, which point the endpoint at the fake AI (e2e/fake-ai.mjs) instead of a real one. The tests that need the model (`withFakeAi`) run only against this local server and are skipped against a real deployment. So the wiring to a model happens in docair's configuration, not in the test code.

steps.title: A question goes in through the page's chat, not to a model
steps.text: The test `a question becomes a walkthrough…` calls the ask helper, which types the question into the page's chat panel. The page posts it to the served project's `/api/ask`; the test never opens a connection to any AI. It only checks what comes back.

steps.title: The server hands the question to docair's ask
steps.text: `docair-server.ask` receives POST /api/ask with the question, the graph and the earlier turns, and calls `docair-ai.ask.ask`. From here on the AI work is docair's, inside the server process.

steps.title: docair's client is the only thing that calls a model
steps.text: `docair-ai.ask.ask` condenses the graph into a digest and calls `docair-ai.client.chat` with the messages. This client is where the graph's lines to a model live: it POSTs to the configured endpoint (`ai-endpoint`, via `docair-ai.client.post`). No test, page or CLI code holds such a line.

steps.title: In the tests, that endpoint is the fake AI
steps.text: Because the settings point at the fake model, the client's POST lands on `docair-e2e.fake-ai.server`, which answers by keywords (`docair-e2e.fake-ai.reply`) so every run gets the same reply. The graph draws the tests' line to the server they start, and the model line stays where it belongs: inside docair.
